title: Add memory receipt backfill dry-run
summary: Memory planning reports identify legacy uncorrelated rows, but operators still need a backfill dry-run and migration boundary before any receipt mutation tool exists.
expectedFailureModes: Backfill tooling mutates memory rows without a dry-run review step.
Legacy uncorrelated rows are counted without stable row identifiers for operator review.
Receipt correlation changes are not auditable before mutation.
nextAction: Design an explicit receipt mutation path later with authorization, before/after evidence, and audit events; current work is dry-run planning only.
